name: TeamStarWolf - Refrigeration-Controller Attacks on European Supermarkets and Blood Services, 2026 (ICS)
description: Curated case-study layer, not an official MITRE mapping. ATT&CK for ICS techniques that the verified record of the 2026 refrigeration-controller attacks on European supermarkets and blood services supports: CERT-FR alert CERTFR-2026-ALE-012 and report CERTFR-2026-CTI-009, France's attribution statement, NCSC Ireland's advisory and the US joint fact sheet, with Sekoia's honeypot telemetry and the Ransom-ISAC site account relayed by Help Net Security. T1694.001 is the v20 successor of the revoked T0812. Each comment names source numbers from case-studies/EUROPEAN_REFRIGERATION_ATTACKS_2026.md. The mappings are this study's reading.

techniques.comment: Controllers reached while exposed to the internet (CERT-FR, 12 to 16 Oct 2026; NCSC-IE, 3 Nov 2026). Sources [1][15] refer to the Sources table of case-studies/EUROPEAN_REFRIGERATION_ATTACKS_2026.md.

Default Administrator credentials at the Ransom-ISAC site (2 Nov 2026); default-account spraying on Sekoia honeypots (Oct to Nov 2026). Successor of the revoked T0812. Sources [19][25] refer to the Sources table of case-studies/EUROPEAN_REFRIGERATION_ATTACKS_2026.md.

Default Administrator credentials at the Ransom-ISAC site (2 Nov 2026); default-account spraying on Sekoia honeypots (Oct to Nov 2026). Successor of the revoked T0812. Sources [19][25] refer to the Sources table of case-studies/EUROPEAN_REFRIGERATION_ATTACKS_2026.md.

Defrost parameters set to high temperatures (11 to 12 Oct 2026); EFS thresholds raised and 743 setpoint changes (2 Nov 2026). Sources [2][23][25] refer to the Sources table of case-studies/EUROPEAN_REFRIGERATION_ATTACKS_2026.md.
Alarm thresholds altered (Sekoia, Nov 2026); alarms muted (Ransom-ISAC, 2 Nov 2026). Sources [19][25] refer to the Sources table of case-studies/EUROPEAN_REFRIGERATION_ATTACKS_2026.md.
Forced continuous heating and defrost cycles (US joint fact sheet, 5 Nov 2026). Sources [11] refer to the Sources table of case-studies/EUROPEAN_REFRIGERATION_ATTACKS_2026.md.
Denial of view listed as an effect (US joint fact sheet, 5 Nov 2026). Sources [11] refer to the Sources table of case-studies/EUROPEAN_REFRIGERATION_ATTACKS_2026.md.
At least 15 fire starts and goods losses (11 to 12 Oct 2026). Sources [2][3] refer to the Sources table of case-studies/EUROPEAN_REFRIGERATION_ATTACKS_2026.md.
Food losses of several tens of millions of euros (France, 9 Nov 2026). Sources [3] refer to the Sources table of case-studies/EUROPEAN_REFRIGERATION_ATTACKS_2026.md.
